claim_text: On January 24, 2024, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned a 47-count indictment in United States v. Ikram Yusuf Mohamed, Suleman Yusuf Mohamed, Aisha Hassan Hussein, Sahra Sharif Osman, Shakur Abdinur Abdisalam, Fadumo Mohamed Yusuf, and Gandi Yusuf Mohamed, also known as Gandi Abdi Kediye, No. 0:24-cr-00015 (ECF 1). Count 1 charges all seven defendants with conspiracy to commit wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 1343. Counts 2–20 charge all seven with wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. § 1343 (interstate emails and Feeding Our Future-to-site payments). Count 21 charges six defendants (all except Gandi Yusuf Mohamed) with conspiracy to commit federal programs bribery, 18 U.S.C. § 371 (object §§ 666(a)(1)(B) and (a)(2)). Counts 22–37 charge federal programs bribery, 18 U.S.C. §§ 666(a)(1)(B) and (a)(2), with Ikram Mohamed named on every row. Count 38 charges all seven with conspiracy to commit money laundering, 18 U.S.C. § 1956(h). Counts 39–47 charge money laundering, 18 U.S.C. § 1957, named per row. Forfeiture allegations incorporate Counts 1–47 and split Counts 1–37 (proceeds, § 981) from Counts 38–47 (§§ 1956/1957, § 982). These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts. Feeding Our Future family, not HSS.
